duplicate_source: The N10 and N11 VDCI snapshots have identical full text. Both original response identities were checked to preserve prior finding lineage; they are one public body, not independent corroboration.

findings.claim: Bluebeam documents a multi-segment path measurement and separate descriptive Subject/Label fields.
findings.application: Present retained parent route and graphic references separately from labels/readings. This is a software interaction example; it does not establish a mechanical graphic-box rule, immutable-parent edit schema or permission to change a route.

findings.claim: MEPdetect acknowledges missed model detections, untraced runs and calibration limits, with outputs requiring drawing review.
findings.application: Keep the original drawing and corrected region visible and preserve partial coverage. Adding parent graphic support cannot establish complete detection, model accuracy or a complete project quantity.

findings.claim: VDCI describes legends as definitions and distinguishes enlarged plans, sections, schematics and details.
findings.application: Retain exact source/view identity while reviewing graphics. A legend, same-looking detail, similar path or common label does not establish physical duct identity or allow borrowing another page graphics.

findings.claim: The selected retained sources do not establish bounding-box containment as proof of duct ink, physical continuity, same-portion identity, class completeness or source semantic correctness.
findings.application: Full-path same-source null-text graphic containment is the existing local structural validation contract. It introduces no semantic ink proof, tolerance, endpoint-only shortcut, curve/flex substitute, automatic correspondence or new quantity rule.

findings.claim: FEMA scale training gives written dimensions precedence in a conflicting sprinkler teaching example.
findings.resolution: D05 remains authoritative. Repairing graphic evidence must preserve whole-run reading checks and any dimension/scale disagreement. No source authorizes clearing a conflict because graphic support has become available.

findings.claim: MEPdetect describes following matching electrical circuit tags across matchlines.
findings.resolution: Do not transfer electrical tag conventions to duct parent correspondence, evidence replacement or cross-page graphic authority; D08 and exact local source identities remain unchanged.

implementation_authority.basis: Parent graphic repair extends existing source/provenance correction to retained parents. Existing local contract requires observation-cited same-source null-text regions to cover every path segment. Notebook sources do not admit that contract or an edit algorithm.

adoption_guidance.behavior: Add or replace explicitly selected current same-source parent graphic references while preserving immutable parent route, group, dimensions, issues, cuts, child observations and original evidence history.
adoption_guidance.basis: Existing local rules and correction provenance, with contextual drawing-review support only.
adoption_guidance.verification_to_add: A retained parent with label-only or missing graphic support remains unknown until selected source graphics cover its complete route; unrelated rows and every child byte stay unchanged.

adoption_guidance.behavior: Keep full-path support validation and whole-run dimension conflict checks independent.
adoption_guidance.basis: Existing graphic validation implementation and D05, not a public containment rule.
adoption_guidance.verification_to_add: Reject label substitution, foreign/stale graphics and middle gaps; full valid parent graphics cannot suppress a conflicting dimension or unresolved source issue.

adoption_guidance.behavior: Keep replacement provenance, any required explicit renewed foreign-reading applicability, and historical export/reopen reviewable.
adoption_guidance.basis: Local immutable-parent/cross-page dependency contract; public sources establish no automatic rebinding.
adoption_guidance.verification_to_add: Stale parent/capture/relationship inputs fail atomically; only affected closure recalculates; original and replacement bounds/history survive export/reopen without inference.

query_decision.reason: No changed mechanical requirement or missing relevant body. Prior completed correction/graphic/cross-page/parent-reading research contains pertinent context and explicit gaps. This task is existing approved-rules/provenance repair, so duplicate queries would add no authority.

limits: Text line ranges are indexed text locations, not original PDF pages; unprovided edition/page metadata remains unknown.
All source freshness is prior 2026-09-14 retained retrievals; no live publisher verification, license grant, software implementation audit or independent duplicate corroboration.
No new graphic tolerance, physical/ink recognition rule, datum/marker correspondence, whole-run conflict exemption or child-evidence exemption is supported by these sources.
